manualChecks.release-review: Final developer review: record candidate hash, budgets and remaining PRD issues, confirm minimum-environment execution and all acceptance evidence before approving.
manualChecks.G3-validation-review: Confirm API and GPU validation were enabled in actual logs and attribute each warning category and unclassified warning to a source/call stack.
manualChecks.U03: Move Viewer and Editor between Retina and non-Retina displays; verify logical layout, picking, resize and restoration.
manualChecks.U04: Select a user TTF/TTC/OTF, verify Korean rich text, missing-font error and recovery.
manualChecks.G6-debug: Debug Viewer/Editor: native open/save success and cancellation, import preview, drag/drop, Gizmo, undo/redo, animation, equipment and save/reopen.
manualChecks.G6-release: Repeat the interactive workflow in Release.
manualChecks.P01-foreground: Keep each P01 window visible and foreground; record any focus/display/occlusion changes and their times.
manualChecks.P05: Record cold import, first visible image and complete runnable deployment size; do not equate runtime initialization with first display.
manualChecks.G8-thermal: Record ambient/power state, heat and throttling observations before and after the 30 minute run.

supportStatus: validation target; minimum-environment execution and manual gates remain required
